title: Building Production RAG: The Complete Guide
content:
## RAG Architecture for Production

Retrieval-Augmented Generation grounds LLMs in your data, eliminating hallucination.

### The RAG Pipeline
1. Ingest: Split docs -> embed -> store in vector DB
2. Retrieve: Query -> embed -> similarity search -> top-k chunks
3. Generate: Inject context into LLM prompt -> answer

### Recommended Stack
- Embedding: nomic-embed-text via Ollama
- Vector DB: Qdrant (self-hosted)
- LLM: Llama 3.3 70B or Claude API
- Orchestration: Dify or AnythingLLM
